name: Weather Radar
description: Animated precipitation radar overlay (RainViewer) with a time slider and playback. Tiles are fetched by the browser, so the Raspberry Pi does no extra work.

default_enabled.description: Show the radar layer on startup

autoplay.description: Start the animation automatically when the layer is turned on

smooth.description: Smooth the radar image instead of showing raw pixels

snow.description: Render snow in its own colours

frame_ms.description: Time each frame stays on screen during playback (ms)

max_native_zoom.description: Highest zoom level with real radar tiles; beyond it the last level is upscaled. The free RainViewer API caps this at 7.

index_url.description: Radar index endpoint. Leave as-is for the free public API; replace it with your own URL if you have a commercial RainViewer feed. Note: the browser calls this URL directly, so anything embedded in it (a key, a token) is visible in the browser's developer tools.
